detailed_descriptions.en: Peck your way to power! Consume endless popcorn to mutate your birb into increasingly powerful forms. Will you remain a bird, or become something... more ? When you're not feasting, step through the portal into dangerous realms. Explore Procedural Dungeons: Battle unique enemies. Boss Battles: Face off against powerful foes to prove your dominance. Take a break from the chaos at the Moonlit Waters. Fishing Minigame: Cast your line to catch dozens of unique fish types. Fill your Fishdex: distinct rarities, shiny variants, and weight records. Manage your Aquarium: Show off your best catches or trade them for buffs. Home is where the twig is. Unlocking powerful passive bonuses, automation features, and helpful companions like the Seagull, Parrow and Sparrow. Social Flock You are not alone! See other players moving in real-time in the park, chat with the flock, and compete for the top spot on the Global Leaderboards for Popcorn Eaten and Fish Caught. Features: Satisfying Idle progression Active RPG-style combat expeditions Hundreds of upgrades and skill trees Retro Pixel Art aesthetic Prestige system for infinite replayability Are you ready to join the flock?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Peck your way to power! Consume endless popcorn to mutate your birb into increasingly powerful forms. Will you remain a bird, or become something... more?

When you're not feasting, step through the portal into dangerous realms.

  • Explore Procedural Dungeons: Battle unique enemies.

  • Boss Battles: Face off against powerful foes to prove your dominance.

Take a break from the chaos at the Moonlit Waters.

  • Fishing Minigame: Cast your line to catch dozens of unique fish types.

  • Fill your Fishdex: distinct rarities, shiny variants, and weight records.

  • Manage your Aquarium: Show off your best catches or trade them for buffs.

Home is where the twig is. Unlocking powerful passive bonuses, automation features, and helpful companions like the Seagull, Parrow and Sparrow.

Social Flock

You are not alone! See other players moving in real-time in the park, chat with the flock, and compete for the top spot on the Global Leaderboards for Popcorn Eaten and Fish Caught.

Features:

  • Satisfying Idle progression

  • Active RPG-style combat expeditions

  • Hundreds of upgrades and skill trees

  • Retro Pixel Art aesthetic

  • Prestige system for infinite replayability

Are you ready to join the flock?
